title: THE LEGEND OF KYRANDIA
subtitle: Westwood Studios, 1992 · the non-interactive demo, on ScummVM 0.10.0 (2007): its Kyra engine
argsHint: -p<dir> where the game is, then its id. The Kyra engine also reads KYRA.DAT, put beside the game's files. Other switches: -g<scaler>, -f full screen, -m<volume> music, -s<volume> effects.
fpsNote: A FALLBACK cap only: the engine paces itself on the SDL clock.

needsData.hint: kyra1-dos-ni-demo-en/files/ from kyra1-dos-ni-demo-en.zip, the demo the ScummVM project distributes, and scummvm-engine-data-0.10.0/KYRA.DAT, the one 0.10.0's own release shipped

controls: nothing: the demo plays itself, and ends
_why: Held to a native g++ build of 0.10.0 frame by frame to its last frame (gate-scummvm010, 872 frames). Before the static member array fix it asserted on its first screens: ARRAYSIZE(_soundFiles) was 0.
